Stop treating your AI coding assistant like an overeager junior dev who dumps messy, untested code into your project. 🛑

Meet Superpowers: a comprehensive methodology and agentic skills framework that transforms your AI tool into a disciplined software architect. 

Here is the problem it solves: 
Most AI tools jump straight into writing code before planning, leading to hallucinations, poor architecture, and missing tests. Superpowers forces a repeatable, predictable pipeline by systematically guiding your agent through requirement brainstorming, architectural planning, isolated git worktrees, and strict Test-Driven Development.

Key features you need right now:
🧠 Automatic skill triggering that mandates brainstorming and spec refinement before a single line of code is written.
🌲 Subagent-driven development that isolates engineering tasks across fresh subagents using clean test baselines and git worktrees.
🔴 Strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR enforcement requiring failing tests before any minimal implementation code goes down.
⚡ Cross-harness compatibility supporting Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Devin, GitHub Copilot, and more.

Whether you are building complex greenfield web applications or safely refactoring legacy codebases, Superpowers breaks features into bite-sized tasks to eliminate context drift and secure 100% test coverage.

👉 Check out the repo and take back control of your workflow:
https://github.com/obra/superpowers

Deconstruct any application, website, or game using a pure Rust reverse-engineering engine and have autonomous coding agents rebuild it from scratch. 🤯

Ever wished you could instantly modernize legacy software, deconstruct complex binaries, or port proprietary apps to a fresh tech stack without spending weeks on manual analysis? 

Meet Craft Anything—a powerhouse open-source, systems-level reverse-engineering and code generation engine built entirely in Rust. It systematically inspects arbitrary software, websites, or games and orchestrates coding agents to design, build, and iteratively verify equivalent functional implementations.

✨ Key Features:
• Pure Rust Reverse Engineering Engine: Over 300 built-in native decoders, disassemblers, and decompilers analyzing codebases, binaries, web assets, and game files with zero external runtime bloat.
• Clean Room vs. Deep Inspection: Choose Clean Room mode to operate strictly from observable external behavior, or unlock Deep mode for comprehensive internal code and file analysis via built-in engines and Ghidra.
• Automated Build Verification Loop: Follows a strict Study, Build, Check, and Ready 4-step process, comparing newly generated code against original targets to iteratively fix discrepancies.
• Model Context Protocol (MCP) Support: Exposes all 320 capabilities uniformly across a native egui desktop app, a robust CLI, and an MCP server so external AI agents can drive the engine directly.

Whether you are auditing native binaries, modernizing outdated monoliths, or prototyping clean-room alternatives, Craft Anything supercharges your dev and AI workflows. 🚀

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything

Transform any Android device's telemetry, permissions, and network footprint into an actionable, reproducible privacy audit report entirely offline. 📱🔒

Are you tired of wondering what your mobile apps are secretly leaking to the cloud? Whether you are an Android developer preparing for production, a security researcher, or a privacy-conscious engineer, auditing apps usually means wrestling with bloated cloud tools or spending hours manually reverse engineering packages. 

Enter NOIR: an offline desktop utility that interfaces with your Android device via ADB to audit application manifests, runtime permissions, and hardcoded network endpoints. It computes risk scores, identifies trackers, translates permissions into real-world data exposure risks, and generates reversible remediation scripts—all without requiring root access or cloud telemetry. 🛑☁️

Key features built for deep inspection:
• On-Device Endpoint Extraction: Uses unzip and strings over ADB to minimize transfer overhead and inspect DEX-level network destinations.
• Data Correlation Mapping: Maps raw permissions to specific data assets like location, contacts, and media, paired with automatic manufacturer and tracker categorization.
• DeepScan Engine: Utilizes local jadx integration to perform static analysis and regex grep for high-risk runtime calls and exported components.
• Automated Remediation Planning: Outputs precise appops configurations and rollback commands for granular privacy control.

Use it to internally audit your own apps for leaked network endpoints and insecure debug flags before shipping, or to analyze pre-installed OEM apps and third-party software for unexpected telemetry and background data leakage. Save hours of manual reverse engineering and keep your data entirely on your machine. 💻✨

Check out the repository and start auditing today:
https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR

Navigating international relocation as a software engineer just got easier with this massive, open-source guide tracking 36 European countries and 110 immigration routes. 🌍✈️

For tech professionals and remote workers, figuring out how to move abroad usually means spending hundreds of hours digging through chaotic, outdated government websites, cross-referencing visa policies, and trying to decode confusing tax laws. 

Enter RUN (https://github.com/BryceYuuu/RUN). This comprehensive, crowdsourced emigration and relocation handbook aggregates up-to-up-to-date immigration pathways specifically for people in tech. 

Here is what makes it an essential reference for your next career move:

🌐 Granular country-by-country breakdowns covering 36 European nations, complete with living costs, salary thresholds, tax info, and processing times.
📂 Clear functional categories for relocation paths including digital nomad visas, skilled tech work permits, EU Blue Cards, study-to-work, and startup options.
⏱️ Regular timestamped updates tracking rapidly shifting policies like British residency changes and Canadian Express Entry rules.
📊 Cross-cutting reference tables comparing residency requirements, path durations, and passport timelines so you can easily weigh your options.

Whether you want to compare EU Blue Card salary limits across tech hubs like Germany, France, and Estonia, or check remote-friendly income thresholds before applying, this structured data reference saves you massive amounts of time. 

Stop guessing at immigration criteria and start planning your next move. Star the repo, check out the documentation, and contribute your own insights if you have been through the process!

Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/BryceYuuu/RUN

Stop wasting hours manually dragging boxes in Figma or Excalidraw just to sketch out a project kickoff or README update. 🎨⏱️

Meet stack-diagram: an open-source AI agent skill that translates a single natural language sentence into a clean, professional architecture diagram with official logos. 🚀

Say goodbye to messy documentation and tedious layout work. This tool automates the entire process directly from your text prompts via AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor.

✨ Key features you'll love:
• Authentic Logos: Automatically fetches unadulterated official brand and cloud provider logos from AWS, GCP, Azure, and curated open sources without altering brand colors.
• Smart Line Routing: Intelligently routes connecting lines around text labels to prevent visual clutter and layout overlap.
• Versatile Exports: Generates standalone HTML files, PNG images via Playwright, dependency-free React components, and native Claude artifacts.
• Dual-Theme Rendering: Supports smart light and dark themes while preserving white icon tiles for brand color fidelity.

Whether you are onboarding new engineers, drafting a client proposal, or mapping out cloud infrastructure for AWS or Azure, this keeps your documentation instantly synchronized with your actual tech stack. ☁️💻

Check it out on GitHub and automate your architecture diagrams today:
